title: wsutil: Make filter lists dynamic and on-demand
description:
Do not read the capture filter list unless needed.

Do not use a static list because the capture filter list can change during program execution
and we want to be able to read multiple copies whenever.

Improve the public API function names.

> the capture filter list can change during program execution

As in "when the user edits it" (which should notify other places within Wireshark), "when the user changes their profile" (ditto), or "when there are two running instances of Wireshark and the list is changed in one instance" (of which the other instance will be ignorant), or something else?

Or is "should notify other places within Wireshark" something that would require ugly code that reaches into a bunch of different places?  In that case, given that users probably won't have so many saved capture filters that repeatedly reading the file would make a noticeable difference, just re-reading the file whenever the list is needed is probably the right answer.

> As in "when the user edits it" (which should notify other places within Wireshark), "when the user changes their profile" (ditto), or "when there are two running instances of Wireshark and the list is changed in one instance" (of which the other instance will be ignorant), or something else?

I was thinking "when the user edits it" (in the GUI or directly in the file).
